connector.name: Agentic Research
connector.registryDescription: Local research agent that verifies its own answers. Runs on Gemma 3 4B + Ollama, $0/query.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agentic-research-engine. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the theaisingularity account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
env.description: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: OpenAI cloud. Use http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the endpoint above. Use 'ollama' as a sentinel value when running locally against Ollama.

env.name: MODEL_SYNTHESIZER
env.description: Model identifier used for the synthesize node. Defaults to 'gpt-5-mini'; set to 'gemma3:4b' for Mac-local Ollama.

env.name: MODEL_PLANNER
env.description: Model for the plan / classify / critic / compress / verify nodes. Defaults to 'gpt-5-nano'.

env.name: EMBED_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model identifier (for retrieval + memory). Default 'text-embedding-3-small'; use 'nomic-embed-text' on Ollama.

env.name: SEARXNG_URL
env.description: Base URL of the SearXNG meta-search instance. Default http://localhost:8888.

env.name: LOCAL_CORPUS_PATH
env.description: Path to an index directory built via scripts/index_corpus.py. When set, local corpus hits augment web search.

env.name: ENABLE_RERANK
env.description: Set to '1' to enable the BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder rerank stage. First run downloads ~560MB.

env.name: ENABLE_FETCH
env.description: Set to '0' to skip the trafilatura full-page fetch stage. Default '1'.
